description: A 3HP blank panel that you load SVG images onto from its own right-click menu, over a choice of six background finishes
notes: the panel shows only its background until you load a picture: right-click it and choose Load SVG...
in Single mode one picture is drawn centred on the panel; in Multiple mode each picture you load is dropped at a random place and angle, tilted by up to 18 degrees either way.
the mode cannot be changed while any picture is loaded. The menu shows a greyed line saying to delete the loaded SVGs first.
each loaded picture gets its own submenu carrying Lock, which holds it in place when Shake runs, and Delete, which removes it whether it is locked or not.
the first time the plugin loads it makes a Sticksy folder in your Rack user folder, with Stickers and Animation inside it, and copies the bundled artwork there.
the file browser opens in that Stickers folder the first time you load a picture in a session.
an SVG that cannot be read is replaced by the plugin's own fallback picture, so a broken path shows something rather than nothing.
the background starts on Black, and every loaded picture, its position and its lock state are saved with the patch.
menu: Mode: Single, Multiple — chooses whether one picture is drawn centred or several are scattered at random places and angles
Load SVG... — opens a file browser and puts the SVG you pick onto the panel
Shake — throws every unlocked picture to a new random place and angle; it appears only in Multiple mode
Storage: Referenced, Save in Sticksy Library — chooses whether the patch points at the file where you found it or at a copy the module makes in the Sticksy folder of your Rack user folder
Lock — on the submenu for one loaded picture: holds that picture where it is when Shake runs
Delete — on the submenu for one loaded picture: removes that picture, locked or not
Background: Neutral, Wood, Metal, Paper, Black, White — sets the finish of the panel the pictures are drawn on
